note: Too still. I want to feel the camera move: a visible slow push toward her as she gets curious about his business.

before.direction: slightly right into her looking space
before.motivation: Let the frame acknowledge her curiosity without leaving her speaking face.

before.lands_on: Anudi waist up with slightly more looking space toward the vehicle
before.composition_note: Keep Anudi left throughout; the small lateral drift must not crop her phone or lose the vehicle edge.

before.camera_sentence: An eye-level medium shot drifts very slowly right as Anudi smiles toward the business and asks her question, retaining her on the left with the phone low and the vehicle edge in depth, then settles.

after.trigger: Anudi smiles and looks toward the food three-wheeler
after.motivation: Make her growing curiosity tangible by visibly closing the distance as she turns her attention to his business.
after.opens_on: Anudi waist up at left, phone low, umbrella above, vehicle edge in right depth
after.lands_on: Anudi chest up at left, looking right with open space toward the business
after.composition_note: Push straight toward her without recentering; preserve her left-side placement and rightward looking room, with the vehicle edge peripheral as the frame tightens.
after.why: A clearly visible but unhurried approach makes her curiosity the first warm invitation inward, connecting his breathing portrait to her view of the business without rivaling the later call.
after.camera_sentence: From an eye-level waist-up medium shot, the camera pushes slowly and visibly toward Anudi as she smiles toward the business and asks her question, settling into a chest-up medium close-up with her face left and looking room right.
